colorCoordinate.system: Pickles+Depagne 2010 Landolt Bm-Vc, Vega system, CALSPEC-calibrated zero points
colorCoordinate.use: template-shape selection only; not a catalogue magnitude correction

wavelengthGrid.normalization: divide each template by its maximum resampled F_lambda over 380-780 nm before 12-decimal quantization; positive scale cancels in Johnson-V transmission ratio
wavelengthGrid.resampling: linear from Pickles atlas samples; no extra spectral information claimed
